prompt: Read-only architecture consult. Alex's actual device is an iPhone 6, which is limited to iOS 12.5.x. We need the fastest honest path to a usable 3D/spatial audio experience on that hardware. Constraints: SwiftUI/iOS27 whole-mix tap are unavailable. Safari/Web Audio exists on iOS 12, but WebKit historically cannot pipe HLS media-element playback into AudioContext. SoundCloud now prefers AAC-HLS. SoundCloud API Terms also prohibit modifying User Content unless the uploader expressly permits it, so the first usable version should target local files, Alex-owned SoundCloud content, or tracks explicitly licensed for derivatives; do not propose ripping/capture or a server proxy for arbitrary third-party tracks. Compare these implementation options: (A) iOS 12 UIKit + AVAudioEngine local-file player, (B) iOS 12 browser/Web Audio local-file player, (C) custom HLS segment ingest for rights-cleared SoundCloud tracks. Recommend the fastest route to something Alex can actually use on an iPhone 6, and a later path to rights-cleared SoundCloud integration. Keep the DSP modest and measurable: ITD-based crossfeed/head-shadow first, HRTF later. Do not modify repository files.
expected_response: Return: Recommendation; Why; iPhone 6 constraints; Fastest MVP architecture; SoundCloud-compliant path; Biggest technical traps; Concrete build sequence. Under 1200 words.
